packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Learn a public interface
value.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
value.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
value.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

execution.progress: repeat counts complete executions. Continuing work retains resolved identity and progress; cancellation releases surviving unconsumed escrow once. Global pauses preserve all work and costs.

value.name: Shell compression opening
value.function: Press one whole unit of your own firm food, such as a nut, once between two rigid pressure surfaces to crack or split its outer layer, or inspect a food unit for its visible outer layer and interior state. Shell and contents cannot be separated in this world.
value.costs: Study: 2 rounds, 0.5 energy each. open: inputStackId, your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated food stack with a whole unit, not soft (hardness above 1); pressureToolIds, one or two of your own whole inedible rigid sound items; with one, supportId is a solid unreserved object of represented material in reach; with two, the second rests on firm ground where you stand. One round, 1 energy, one unit per attempt. inspect: inputStackId, your own food stack; one round, 0.2 energy. Both need light: outdoors daylight above 0.1, indoors light above 0.1. separate is refused. All checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate.
value.effects: Strength is hardness / 10. The load reaching the unit is the lower of the two surfaces’ strength x (1 - flexibility). If it is not above the unit’s strength the outer layer holds and nothing changes. Otherwise damage (load - strength) / strength is added and kept on the unit: at 1 its outer layer splits open and the interior is exposed, below 1 it stays cracked and closed and can be pressed again. A larger stack gives up one unit; the rest is unchanged. The surfaces carry no more than their own strength, so they are not damaged. The unit stays one whole carried unit with its mass, nutrition, origin, age and decay; shell and kernel parts, masses and yield are not represented, so nothing detaches and nothing is separated. Inspect records the visible outer layer, crack, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration (of the interior only once exposed) and quantity as an unverified approximate record; edibility, nutrition, toxins and safety stay unknown. No eating, refund or reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; a compression commits only when its round completes, and its crack or opening stays on the unit. No work, escrow or process persists.

value.question: Which nearby foods can support a reliable, varied food supply?
evidence: Starting knowledge identifies berries as nutrition 8 and toxicity 0, and roots as nutrition 14 and toxicity 0.
One berry was successfully gathered at tick 2 and remains owned at tick 3.
A second gathering attempt at forest-berry-1 failed due to a simultaneous resource or swept-body conflict.
At tick 3, start-2-berries visibly holds 5 berries and start-1-nuts holds 5 hazelnuts.
value.uncertainty: Hazelnut food properties, preparation requirements and source replenishment remain untested.
value.goal: Establish an evidence-based local food routine with a safe reserve.
outputs: One owned berry observed at tick 3.
value.missing: A modest food reserve, direct hazelnut observations and evidence about replenishment.
value.next: Collect from a separate berry patch, eat and rest, then observe hazelnuts.
value.benefit: The initial harvest provides a known-safe food item; recognizing contention supports choosing a different source.
